name: object_contact_v4
changed_factors: object_contact_v3 behavior is retained as the control
a bounded same-frame upper outer ring may support frozen candidate geometry
the strict seed-connected component remains the only contact/collision target mask
generator anchors maximize local upper support within the inherited 15 mm displacement cap
outer-ring pixels never receive contact or collision exemptions
when both retained approaches are blocked by a measured non-target pixel, one blocker-away axis is tested within a 55 degree tilt cap
world-down and camera-ray approach hypotheses are retained
prompt: Point to visible grasp contact locations on the {noun} at the tail, or start, of the green arrow. Ignore the arrowhead and destination. Choose locations where a parallel-jaw gripper can descend from above, straddle the object, and close without touching nearby objects or support surfaces. Point only on the {noun}.
